summary: This codebase shows strengths in modular architecture with many well-defined components but has systemic issues around file sizes (19 files exceed 800-line limit), error handling (36+ instances of bare except Exception with pass), and type safety (30+ type: ignore suppression comments). The largest concentration of issues is in core/ (coordinator.py at 1634 lines, evaluation_harness.py at 1578 lines, distributed_speculative.py at 1526 lines) and api/server.py (1732 lines). Error handling is the most critical pattern: exceptions are frequently caught broadly and silently discarded, especially in dashboard WebSocket handler, cloud provider adapters, and the SSO auth module. The type: ignore comments scattered across 20+ files indicate the type system is not fully leveraged. File-level complexity is the most pervasive issue: 6 files exceed 1000 lines, with the top 12 files alone accounting for over 16,000 lines of code. Many files would benefit from decomposition into smaller, focused modules.
